note: Atlanta City Charter section 5-102 sets the regular general election for mayor in November 1997 and every four years after that (1997, 2001, 2005, 2009, 2013, 2017, 2021, 2025). Section 3-101 gives the mayor a four-year term. This year is not in that cycle. The charter holds a special election for mayor only after a vacancy (section 5-103); this check found no record of such a vacancy election in this year.
